name: qsv-explode
description: Explode rows into multiple ones by splitting a column value based on the given separator. The inverse of `implode`.

args.name: column
args.description: The column to operate on. See 'qsv select --help' for the selection syntax.

args.name: separator
args.description: The separator string used to split/join values.

args.name: input
args.description: Input CSV file. If not specified, reads from stdin.

options.description: The field delimiter for reading CSV data. Must be a single character. (default: ,)
When set, the first row will not be interpreted as headers.
Write output to <file> instead of stdout.
New name for the exploded column.
